attr.title: Gunslugs 2
attr.desc: Run, jump and shoot through chaotic action-platforming missions against the Black Duck Army.
attr.inst: Install Gunslugs2.zip, then copy your owned Gunslugs2.jar into the installed gunslugs2 folder. See gunslugs2.md for supported files and installation steps. Requires compatible 64-bit ARM firmware and PortMaster Java 17 and Westonpack runtimes.
